text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Bour-bon! Bour-bon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today's main attraction is definitely 
Bourbon. Following in Teio's footsteps 
from last year, I hope she gives it her 
all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh. Didn't you say at her debut that the 
Classics were impossible for Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The past is the past! The Satsuki Sho 
completely changed my mind!

Various murmurs could be heard drifting 
from the stands. Meanwhile, in the waiting 
roomâ

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *phew*...

After the Satsuki Sho, crowd expectations 
grew, believing Mihono Bourbon was more 
than capable of competing in the Classics.

I was a little worried that might put too 
much pressure on her, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There is no causal link between my 
condition and the opinions of others.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Derby, I will definitely 
seize victory.

I breathe a sigh of relief at Mihono 
Bourbon's reassuring words. Just then—
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice-san. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry to bother you when you're busy...! 
Um, do you have a quick moment...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... there's something I want to tell 
you...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, there is no problem.

With a nervous expression, Rice Shower 
took a small, deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice has always thought Bourbon-san 
was such an incredible Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A cool Umamusume who has the power to make 
everyone smile—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice always wanted to become like that 
someday. But... but...!

—And as if making up her mind, Rice Shower 
looked up at Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
During the Satsuki Sho, I realized... If 
Rice doesn't change, that "someday" will 
never come...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice has to graduate from being timid 
already...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why— Rice will catch up today...!

Eyes that should have been timid and 
hesitant sparkled with immense strength 
for a single moment.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you later...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
………… I've never seen Rice-san like that 
before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...No, but... it doesn't matter. All I 
have to do is win.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will be crowned this year's Derby 
Umamusume? The curtain is about to rise on 
the Nippon Derby!
